description: Optional fail-open Autopilot hooks. Command hooks (Python) guard catastrophic Bash commands, check autopilot dispatch briefs for acceptance criteria, and nudge about open ledger rows; they resolve enforcement from CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_ENFORCEMENT (userConfig.enforcement), then ~/.autopilot/config.jsonc, defaulting to advisory. The function-hooks module (register.tsx) adds the Fable gate for security-engineer, a nested-spawn backstop, and the read-only /ledger pane; it reads userConfig.enforcement only.
